title: Renewables Lab: US transition investigation
assumptions: Six illustrative regions, hourly dispatch, capacity-limited hub links with explicit end-to-end losses and timed outages, energy-conserving demand shifts, empty starting storage, 88% round-trip storage efficiency. Not calibrated to the US grid; not a forecast.

notes.text: Solar output is zero at this local hour. Extra solar capacity cannot supply this hour directly.
The regional link has unused capacity. Imports also depend on surplus and link capacity elsewhere.
Storage starts this hour empty. More duration alone would not create stored energy.

comparisons.label: Scenario 2
comparisons.prediction: More solar should reduce fossil backup, but may leave an evening gap.
comparisons.reflection: Solar lowers fossil use, but the evening still needs backup.
